scope: Authored quantities with stipulated legal standing/priority only; not actual rights, needs, values, tax, judgments, a court simulator or a country forecast
limits: All numerical legal/value assumptions are authored. Amounts are arbitrary common units; child amounts are a separate monthly price fixture, not the old national cohort schedule.
The joint estate excludes other peoples shares and joint debt once; private/secured/support priorities are stipulated, not determined by the check.
Estate example uses zero assumed transfer tax only for arithmetic; C06 progressive estate/large-gift policy is not amended. Actual tax is unknown.

Obligor C/E is stipulated before this period child payment; already received in-kind credit is counted once against its share, not another resource. Means-tested public bridging is not private income or canceled private duty.
Gross annual judge hours cannot establish urgent 24-hour coverage, full costs, actual independent staff, evidence or accepted safe receiving.
No automated parentage, capacity, clinical choice, custody, wills, title or liability decision follows from these inputs or checks.
